test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'option 1' **i.e. **"discovered".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context **of this sentence, the team of scientists has mapped the seabed and found something that resembles an asteroid impact crater.
 
• The word **"discovered" **fits best here, as it denotes the action of finding something unexpected or previously unknown.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: *The ocean floor is famously less explored than the surface of Mars. And when our team of scientists recently mapped the seabed, and ancient sediments beneath, we **discovered** what looks like an asteroid impact crater. Intriguingly, the crater, (3)______ “Nadir” after the nearby volcano Nadir Seamount, is of the same age as the Chicxulub impact caused by a huge asteroid at the end of the Cretaceous (4)______, around 66 million years ago, which (5)______ the dinosaurs and many other species.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"Screened"** generally means to view or examine something, but in this context, it doesn't capture the idea of finding something new or unexpected.
 
• **"Shaped"** means to give a particular shape or form to something, but this doesn't fit the context here as the scientists aren't creating or forming the asteroid impact crater.
 
• **"Founded"** refers to establishing or setting up an institution or organization, which doesn't fit in the context of this sentence as the scientists are finding something, not setting up an organization.
